hooks.command: jq -c --arg sha "$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null)" '{t:(now|todate), ev:.hook_event_name, session:.session_id, tool:.tool_name, sha:$sha} + (if $ENV.HARNESS_RUN then {data:{run:$ENV.HARNESS_RUN}} else {} end)' >> .harness/events.jsonl
jq -c '{t:(now|todate), ev:"stop", session:.session_id} + (if $ENV.HARNESS_RUN then {data:{run:$ENV.HARNESS_RUN}} else {} end)' >> .harness/events.jsonl
